description.fr-FR: L’acte de consécration au Père, au Fils et à l’Esprit-Saint que dom Marmion composa le jour de Noël 1908 et renouvela à Paray-le-Monial en mars 1909 : le résumé de ses « lumières » sur le Christ et la réponse à tant d’appels divins. Texte cité par dom Raymond Thibaut dans « Dom Columba Marmion, un maître de la vie spirituelle ».
description.en-US: The act of consecration to the Father, the Son and the Holy Spirit that Dom Marmion wrote on Christmas Day 1908 and renewed at Paray-le-Monial in March 1909. French text as quoted by Dom Raymond Thibaut in his biography; no English translation is included.
description.pt-BR: O ato de consagração ao Pai, ao Filho e ao Espírito Santo que dom Marmion compôs no Natal de 1908 e renovou em Paray-le-Monial em março de 1909. Texto citado por dom Raymond Thibaut em sua biografia.

fr-FR.editor: Dom Raymond Thibaut, O.S.B. (quoted in Dom Columba Marmion, Maredsous, 2nd ed.)

sources.edition: Dom Raymond Thibaut, Dom Columba Marmion, abbé de Maredsous, un maître de la vie spirituelle, 2e éd., Maredsous, 1930, p. 190. Internet Archive scan, OCR text.
sources.description: The act of consecration only, transcribed from the biography (whose OCR reads à as 4 or A) and corrected by hand. Marmion’s many letters quoted in the biography are not imported.
sources.tierEvidence: Marmion’s own text (died 1923), quoted in a 1930 work.
